text: CONTRADICTING: Proteomics showed that 53 of 84 detected lysosomal hydrolases and V-ATPases were significantly downregulated in APOE44 vs APOE33 iMG. Lower acidification machinery argues against more acidic endo-lysosomes in APOE4 (reported: 53/84 proteins downregulated).
description: Isogenic APOE33/APOE44 KOLF2.1J human iPSC-derived microglia; DIA LC-MS/MS proteomics; n=3 wells each; unpaired t-test with Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Caveat: microglia, not astrocytes; protein abundance is an indirect surrogate for luminal pH, and V-ATPases are pooled with hydrolases.

provenance.excerpt: Of the 84 identified lysosomal hydrolases and V-ATPases, 53 were significantly downregulated in APOE44 iMG, supporting lysosomal impairment (Figure S3D).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> lower lysosomal hydrolase/V-ATPase protein levels (proton pump machinery) in iPSC-derived microglia [CONTRADICTS]

warnings: effect size '53/84 proteins downregulated' has no accepted form: recorded as qualitative, numbers kept in description

perturbed.variable: APOE44 vs APOE33 genotype (isogenic KOLF2.1J iPSC-derived microglia)

measured.variable: Protein abundance of lysosomal hydrolases and V-ATPase subunits (proteomics)
